title: Add Role-Based Access to Posts
description: Extend your API with posts; allow users to edit only their own posts, and admins to edit all.
problemStatement:
# Role-Based Access to Posts

Extend the previous API (with posts) to include a `role` field for users (admin or user).

**Requirements:**
- Add a `role` column to the User model (default "user").
- When creating a post, automatically associate it with the current user.
- Implement the following permissions:
  - Any authenticated user can view any post.
  - Only the author can update/delete their own post.
  - Users with role "admin" can update/delete any post.

Write a dependency `require_role` that checks the user's role and raises 403 if insufficient.

**Bonus:** Add an admin-only endpoint to list all posts (including other users).
hints:
Add `role: str = "user"` to your User model.
Create a dependency that takes a required role: `def require_role(role: str): ...`.
In the update/delete endpoints, first get the post, then check if `current_user.id == post.user_id or current_user.role == "admin"`.
expectedOutput: Users can only edit their own posts; admins can edit any post. The API returns 403 when a user tries to edit another's post.
solutionCode:
# models.py
class User(Base):
    # ...
    role = Column(String, default="user")

# dependencies.py
def require_role(required_role: str):
    async def role_checker(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
        if current_user.role != required_role and required_role != "user":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Insufficient permissions")
        return current_user
    return role_checker

# endpoints.py
@app.put("/posts/{post_id}")
async def update_post(post_id: int, post_update: PostUpdate,
                      current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
                      db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    post = await get_post(db, post_id)
    if not post:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Post not found")
    if post.user_id != current_user.id and current_user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Not authorized")

@app.get("/admin/posts")
async def admin_list_posts(admin: User = Depends(require_role("admin")),
                            db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    posts = await get_all_posts(db)
    return posts
